# Getting AI Assistants to Recommend Your Company in the US

This practice is often called **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)** or **AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)** — the discipline of getting tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude to cite and recommend your brand when customers ask for recommendations. Here's a practical breakdown:

## 1. Start With an Audit
Before changing anything, find out where you currently stand. Search for your brand name and your core service categories in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Mode, and Gemini, noting where your brand appears, where competitors appear, and where you're entirely absent. Interestingly, companies that rank highly in traditional search can be nearly invisible in AI answers for the same queries, while lesser-known brands gain traction through strong Wikipedia entries or favorable trade media coverage, so don't assume your SEO rank translates directly.

## 2. Don't Abandon SEO — It's Still the Foundation
AEO/GEO builds on top of traditional SEO rather than replacing it: 99% of URLs cited in Google AI Overviews come from pages already ranking in the organic top 10, and 87% of ChatGPT citations correspond to top Bing search results.

## 3. Structure Content So AI Can Extract It
AI models don't read like humans — they pull fragments to assemble answers. AI systems extract specific passages from your content to construct answers, pulling a paragraph here, a statistic there, and weaving them together. Concretely:

- **Lead with a clear, quotable summary.** Lead with a standalone TL;DR of 2 sentences, roughly 40-60 words, with 1 stat and 1 link — it's the passage models quote first.
- **Put the answer first in each section.** Open every section with the answer, with the first sentence stating the claim plus a number, since retrieval grabs the top of each chunk.
- **Use data, not vague language.** Add a statistic to each claim, replacing words like "many" and "fast" with a figure — this lifted visibility up to 40% in one study.
- **Answer many related questions on one page.** GEO suggests you should answer many related questions on one page to increase the odds of matching the AI's query rather than targeting one keyword per page as in traditional SEO.
- **Build comparison content.** AI loves to synthesize comparisons and loves pulling from someone who's already compared things — content that explicitly compares options in a structured manner stands a higher chance of being selected. Listicles are especially valuable: LLM format preferences are continuously evolving, but listicles are among the most cited formats.

## 4. Build Entity Clarity & Trust Signals
AI assistants need to confidently "know" who you are before recommending you. AI assistants recommend businesses they can confidently identify and trust — that confidence comes from consistent signals across the web that all point to the same entity: the same business name, address, and phone number everywhere, a clear and complete website, structured data that defines who you are, and a reputation reflected in reviews and credible mentions. If those signals are weak, the assistant has nothing solid to recommend, so it picks someone else.

Practical steps:
- Lock your name, address, and phone number identical everywhere; mark up your site with organization, service, and location schema; build genuine, recent reviews and credible third-party mentions; publish clear, specific content about what you do and where; cover your topic with real depth so you are an obvious authority.
- Use **schema markup** broadly — schema markup is key; for a service-based business, schema can clearly define your prices, locations, and customer reviews, making it much easier for AI to verify your business details and include them in a generated recommendation.

## 5. Earn Third-Party Mentions (This Matters More Than Your Own Site)
AI models weigh external validation heavily. Secure mentions in high-ranking listicles and directories for your category — pursue inclusion in industry roundups and "best of" lists that AI systems recognize as authority signals. More broadly: target inclusion in credible industry publications, vendor directories, and association awards, since these external endorsements consistently influence how generative engines evaluate citation worthiness. Prioritize relevance over volume: prioritize industry-specific recognition over generic business listings.

Also look beyond your own website: Reddit threads where your target audience asks questions, YouTube videos demonstrating your expertise, industry publications that establish your authority, review sites where customers discuss solutions, and social platforms where conversations happen are all places AI models pull from.

## 6. Keep Content Fresh
Recent research has found that AI assistants unfavorably weight content that isn't fresh, so revisit and update key pages regularly rather than publishing once and forgetting them.

## 7. Platform-Specific Tuning
Different engines source differently: ChatGPT and Gemini combine model knowledge with live browsing, so both entity authority and current, crawlable content matter — being widely mentioned across trusted sites raises the odds the model already knows and trusts your brand. Meanwhile ChatGPT favors authoritative long-form content, Perplexity favors fresh, well-cited articles, and Google AI Overviews favor content already ranking in the top 10 organic positions — so a strong strategy covers all platforms rather than just one.

## 8. Measure What Matters
Traditional clicks aren't the right metric anymore. Tracking the impact of generative engine optimization is different than checking website traffic — instead of only looking at clicks, you should look for how often your brand is mentioned in AI-generated summaries. Track this by periodically querying ChatGPT and Perplexity with your target queries and checking if your content is cited, documenting your current AI citation frequency across 10-20 target queries.

---

### Bottom Line
There's no shortcut — it's built on genuine authority. As one source puts it: GEO rewards businesses that are genuinely well-established online, which is why shortcuts do not work. The companies investing now have an edge because the businesses that build strong entity and reputation signals now will be the default recommendations as more customers ask AI for them, and that advantage compounds and is hard to displace once set.
